results.title: Cutting Through Rocks
results.overview: 37-year-old Sara Shahverdi, a motorcycle riding, land owning, former midwife-turned-fierce citizen advocate and recent divorcée, just won a landslide local election in her remote Iranian village and everyone has an opinion about it.

results.title: Jazz Infernal
results.overview: Koffi, a young Ivorian trumpeter, arrives in Montréal with nothing but the legacy of his father to guide him. Lost between the city’s noise and the silence of his past, he must confront his roots to finally find his voice.

results.title: BAKA's Identity
results.overview: To get by, Takuya and Mamoru pose as women in an online scheme, but when they try to leave this life, they must rely on their dangerous mentor for help.

results.title: teeth
results.overview: What language, what images exist for the consequences of violence? The consequences of violence on the individual, on the environment? An experiment between animated film and literary text.

results.title: Letters
results.overview: A previously unknown short by Gunvor Nelson, discovered in 2023 along with approximately 150 rolls of film in her apartment.

results.title: Rockstar: DUKI from the End of the World
results.original_title: Rockstar: DUKI desde el fin del mundo
results.overview: Argentine trap star Duki gives an intimate look at his past and career, from early rap battles to his rise as a verified hitmaker in this documentary.

results.title: Hyde
results.overview: A dark comedy about a prisoner's last meal on death row.

results.title: PEEPHOLE
results.overview: A radically conservative security systems installer suspects a conspiracy when he does a job for his sister’s workplace: the campaign office of a democratic mayor.

results.title: The Falling Sky
results.overview: Documentary about Indigenous peoples' profound connection to nature and their struggle against deforestation, a grave threat to their way of life and the ecosystem they call home.

results.title: Dear Anderson
results.overview: A man in a recovery group must write a letter to someone who hurt him.

results.title: Véier méint
results.overview: Luxembourg soldier Daniel is about to embark on a four-month training mission. For several months now, the 20-year-old has been spending a lot of time with Sabrina, a young woman from Trier. Things are getting serious between the two of them, and feelings have developed. While out at a disco, he finally introduces her to his fellow soldiers. But Leo, one of them, has something very intimate to reveal about Sabrina.

results.title: The Crossroads
results.overview: Roman Catholic priest Anders has begun to doubt his role as a clergyman due to past misfortunes and experiences when the phone at the parish hall suddenly rings.

results.title: Sarzameen
results.overview: Set in Kashmir, the film follows an Indian Army officer who discovers that his estranged son has joined a militant group.

results.title: Between Borders
results.overview: In a crumbling Soviet Union, the Petrosyan family finds themselves as outcasts—wherever they go. Their Armenian heritage marks them for discrimination, first in their home country of Azerbaijan and then in Russia. After finding their eternal hope through a church planted by American missionaries, the hostility of everyday life pushes them to seek refuge in the United States. In the shadow of exile, hope became their home. Based on a riveting true story of faith and hope set amidst great oppression.

results.title: Laws of Man
results.overview: A pair of U.S. marshals search for a wanted murderer in Nevada at the height of the Cold War and encounter more than they bargained for.

results.title: Call Me Mother
results.overview: Twinkle is a single queer mother whose dream of officially adopting her son gets shaken when the boy's biological mother, Mara, unexpectedly reappears.

results.title: Lobby
results.overview: A CEO of a small tech company, Chang-wook, must win billions worth bid for National EV charger project against Gwang-woo, an ex-business partner who has thrived with lobbying after stealing Chang-wook's original technology. Discovering Gwang-woo's secret connection with the decision-maker Minister Cho, he plans his first-ever golf outing to win over the deal. Finally, the golf round day has come, but everything is not the way he planned. Scandal, betrayal and chase in this 18-hole round.

results.title: Lingering Shadows
results.overview: A woman inherits a box from her late father, who died alone - leaving behind more than just memories.
